topic: Smart Pointers: std::unique_ptr for Automatic Deletion
explanation: In modern C++, smart pointers such as std::unique_ptr provide automatic and exception-safe memory management by owning a dynamically allocated object. Unlike raw pointers, smart pointers automatically delete the managed object when they go out of scope, preventing memory leaks. std::unique_ptr enforces exclusive ownership, meaning only one unique_ptr can own a given object at a time, which simplifies resource management and aligns with RAII (Resource Acquisition Is Initialization) principles.
